phase_prompt.prompt_block: A medium shot of the 'Command' entity in its default state. The black obsidian armor plates are perfectly aligned, revealing the steady pulse of liquid gold beneath. The faceless head displays a static, glowing Ge'ez symbol of authority. Background is a dark, industrial void with faint grid lines. Cinematic lighting, sharp focus, 8k, unreal engine 5 render style.
